title: Business
text: GPT Healthcare Limited (“the Company”) is engaged in the Healthcare Services i.e running of hospitals and providing medical services. We operate a chain of mid-sized full service hospitals under the brand name of “ILS Hospitals” and provide integrated healthcare services, with a focus on secondary and tertiary care. We presently operate five multispecialty hospitals in Dum Dum, Salt Lake and Howrah in West Bengal, Agartala in Tripura and Raipur in Chhattisgarh with a total capacity of 719 beds.
